source='''def transform(grid):
    g = [list(row) for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Full uniform rows/columns are panel separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # A separator color crosses the grid in a row/column; keep those lines intact.
    if sep_rows or sep_cols:
        bg_candidates = [g[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                         if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols]
        bg = max(set(bg_candidates), key=bg_candidates.count)
        rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
        cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
        row_spans = [(rb[i] + 1, rb[i+1]) for i in range(len(rb)-1)]
        col_spans = [(cb[i] + 1, cb[i+1]) for i in range(len(cb)-1)]
        cells = []
        for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
            for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
                tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in g[r0:r1]]
                score = sum(v != bg for row in tile for v in row)
                cells.append((score, ri, ci, tile))
        _, src_ri, src_ci, tile = max(cells, key=lambda x: x[0])
        th, tw = len(tile), len(tile[0])
        out = [row[:] for row in g]
        for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
            for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
                if ri == src_ri and ci == src_ci:
                    continue
                for dr, r in enumerate(range(r0, r1)):
                    for dc, c in enumerate(range(c0, c1)):
                        out[r][c] = tile[dr % th][dc % tw]
        return out
    # With no drawn dividers, extend the populated bottom tile upward when
    # the top rows are entirely background-colored.
    bg = max({v for row in g for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in g for x in row))
    first = next((r for r, row in enumerate(g) if any(v != bg for v in row)), h)
    if 0 < first < h:
        tile = [row[:] for row in g[first:]]
        th = len(tile)
        out = [row[:] for row in g]
        for r in range(first):
            out[r] = tile[(r - first) % th][:]
        return out
    return g
'''
